problem: The owner correctly ran v1 but it exited127 without output. This was a helper linkage bug, not incorrect owner commands.
visible_diagnostic: symbol dlopen version GLIBC_2.17 not defined in file libc.so.6 with link time reference
cause: Modern workstation glibc merges libdl into libc. Linking v1 with -ldl produced only DT_NEEDED libc.so.6 and attributed dlopen/dlsym GLIBC_2.17 to libc. The ONT glibc2.27 provides these in separate libdl.so.2. v1 suppressed stderr before its first lazy dlopen resolution, hiding the relocation error. Minimum symbol version alone did not establish compatibility.
fixes: Explicitly link the original target libdl.so.2, preserving DT_NEEDED libdl.so.2 and attributing dlopen/dlsym GLIBC_2.17 to that provider.
Enable BIND_NOW so startup relocation failures appear before stderr suppression.
Add a 15-second alarm with stage-specific secret-free timeout JSON; no updater or configuration change.
